race.comment: SHAMANSARA (14) is a promising mare lining up for her third start. She won well sitting back off a strong tempo on debut at Cranbourne, well backed at Sandown Hillside last time when racing a bit keen on the pace over a mile. Shinn goes on here and back to 1400m, she can take a sit and let rip off a good speed again. PROVEN SOUL (13) is racing well without winning, good up in grade at Flemington last time when fifth. She maps beautifully with Lane taking the ride. STAY HUMBLE (6) struggled at Sandown Hillside last time but had been racing well prior. He'll need some early luck getting across but can bounce back. CELESTIAL ZARA (11) resumed with a narrow win at Murtoa. This is tougher but she's promising and should improve quickly. EL TERCERO (2) was well backed at Flemington last time but just fair - the Mildura win prior reads quite well. Respecting.
